html:
Gasoline is a clear petroleum-derived flammable liquid that is used primarily as a fuel in most spark-ignited internal combustion engines. Gasoline is an asset manufactured using an Oil refinery. Gasoline can be used in exports, consumed by Gas stations or sold.
